concept: Data transfer: inter-Region traffic is billed — process in the same Region
tests: Understanding the data transfer cost model: what increases cost when processing S3 objects.
expected: Avoid transferring data to EC2 in another Region — inter-Region transfer is billed; processing in the same Region is cheap. Triggers: "minimize data transfer cost", "same Region", "What should they avoid".
why_not: Reading from S3 to EC2 in the same Region is free/cheap; S3 Standard provides the required durability; a gateway endpoint for S3 actually reduces cost (bypasses NAT).
